day.prompt:
Generate a brand new clean cinematic environment concept illustration, NOT an edit, no image inputs. A single landscape image, 1536x1024. An empty compact antique postal workroom above the clouds, for a small angel kitten. NO characters, NO text, NO collage. Warm tactile realistic wood, moss sage green plaster walls, dark walnut wainscoting and plank floor, subtle handmade storybook atmosphere but physical furnishings, crisp undistorted joinery and objects, not a cavernous hall.

Camera: from front right looking diagonally towards left arched window and rear wall, natural 35mm perspective, room modest about 3.5m wide. Left wall: a large FULLY OPEN UNGLAZED wooden arch opening directly overlooking golden daytime clouds. Only outer arched wooden frame and low sill exist: NO GLASS, NO TRANSPARENT PANES, NO SASH, NO vertical mullions, NO horizontal bars, NO crossing framework. Uninterrupted view and open air across the entire arch; small trailing green vines and white daisies around arch. A continuous walnut writing desk UNDER the window extends from foreground left toward rear left. Green leather rectangular desk pad on its center. Exactly ONE black antique mechanical typewriter centered ON that pad, ivory circular keys, blank paper and carriage lever. Typewriter rectangle, pad rectangle, adjacent shallow wooden letter tray, and desk share EXACT SAME two vanishing point axes: parallel corresponding edges. Keyboard faces desk worker aisle obliquely to camera, NOT a front-facing product photograph. Brass banker lamp with green glass shade on left behind machine, small ivory sprout pencil mug beside it. Shallow wooden letter tray on near left tabletop. At far right end of desk only two low sage/tan folders and small potted plant: NO drawer cabinet built on top of desk, no hutch.

CRITICAL FLOORPLAN: immediately to the RIGHT OF THE DESK'S END, touching the left desk edge, stands a SEPARATE floor-to-ceiling-ish walnut MAIL DRAWER CABINET (about 1.8m tall, 1.3m wide, 0.40m deep). This cabinet stands ON THE FLOOR, its base and plinth visible, NOT atop tabletop. Large useful capacity: FOUR columns of SEVEN small rectangular drawers, total28, aligned in a precise regular grid, brass ring pulls and small blank label holders. All drawers closed, including lowest row. Its front faces camera/room parallel to rear wall, physically separate object with straight upright sides. The desk visibly terminates against cabinet's LEFT SIDE at writing height. Its RIGHT SIDE TOUCHES the LEFT SIDE of the separate LOW sideboard by the exit: tightly SIDE-BY-SIDE as two independent furniture units against SAME BACK WALL, no gap. Their FRONT PLANES are FLUSH, SAME DEPTH, so sideboard double doors can swing FORWARD into unobstructed room floor; tall cabinet must never protrude forward across the low cabinet's left door opening. Both front faces and their full forward opening swept area stay unobstructed; practical floor clearance. No cabinet merged into desk, no raised cabinetry on desk.

At back wall just LEFT of the right-hand exit: a separate low double-door walnut sideboard with a small wooden card file box and ivory daisy vase atop it. Above: little framed sprout drawing, single warm wall sconce. The sideboard LEFT SIDE directly TOUCHES the wider tall cabinet RIGHT SIDE, side-by-side aligned fronts, no gap and no overlapping. On RIGHT wall/back-right corner an open tall wooden door with circular brass porthole, opening out toward bright cloud sea. Wall map and two small brass hooks right of door. Clear aisle leads to door. A faded narrow oriental rug lies in middle aisle, not under cabinet fronts.

LADDERS: an original modest TWO-STEP wooden desk step-stool remains beneath/front of working desk, empty. A DIFFERENT slim folding THREE-RUNG wooden cat ladder is FOLDED FLAT and PARKED AGAINST THE NEAR LEFT WALL BESIDE THE NEAR END OF DESK, on the near-left foreground edge of image. It is portable and stored out of use, NOT in front of tall cabinet, NOT leaning on drawer fronts, NOT between cabinets, NOT at door. Entire floor immediately in front of ALL tall cabinet drawers is EMPTY and usable. Show ladder folded, not deployed. No additional ladders/stools/chairs.

Daylight: golden late afternoon cloud light through FULLY OPEN UNGLAZED left arch and right open door, gentle warm banker lamp and sconce. All furniture feet planted coherently. Clean newly rendered details, no ghost contours, grid texture, warped drawers, duplicate machine, split walls or impossible intersections. Prioritize plausible separate furniture arrangement and free opening clearance over decorative density.
FINAL EMPHASIS: EXACTLY FOUR VERTICAL COLUMNS of mail drawers. Tall cabinet and right lower sideboard directly adjoin, with front faces aligned. Window arch completely empty open air inside outer frame, zero glass or window grid. Single coherent fresh full render. Keep foldaway ladder at left out of use and no ladder blocking either cabinet. No distant castle, no added furniture.
